name: Star winding with accessible neutral
summary: An accessible-neutral star winding brings the common star point to a documented terminal.
description: An accessible-neutral star winding brings the common star point to a documented terminal. Earthing and neutral loading details are supplied separately by the system design.
readingNotes: Trace the neutral conductor separately from protective earth.
